name: Smooth

modes.label: Managed browser service
modes.note: Session tariff cannot be normalized to 4 vCPU/8 GiB without guaranteed resource specifications.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom; unlimited credits/concurrent browsers, single tenant, BYOC, BAA, SSO/SAML.

features.ip_note: Default egress is Smooth's datacenter IP; bring-your-own proxy (Starter $50/mo and up) or proxy_server="self" P2P tunnel to egress via your own (e.g. residential) IP; no managed residential proxy or per-GB price published. Browser API is a session tool API (goto/extract/evaluate_js), no CDP endpoint documented.

caveats: Browser agent step $0.005; plans include API credits, not guaranteed browser CPU/RAM hours. Enterprise custom. A step-to-hours conversion cannot be inferred.
No invented browser vCPU or memory allocation: normalized 4/8 rate remains null. Proxy traffic is not necessarily equivalent to sandbox egress.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Only published meter is $0.005 per agent step (docs.smooth.sh/pricing, re-checked 2026-09-28); no per-browser-hour or per-resource rate exists, so the card stays unpriced for hour-based workloads. Free plan: $5 welcome credit. Starter concurrency: pricing page says 10 browsers, docs say 5 (card keeps 10).

fleet.verification: No card required for free signup.
fleet.tiers: Free 2; Starter 10 on pricing but 5 in docs (conflict); Growth 50; Enterprise unlimited by contact.
fleet.notes: 10 on Starter requires confirmation due to conflicting official values. 50 fits Growth; 300/1,000 Enterprise.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.note: Sessions end on close ('Close the session and save any profile changes.'); only browser profiles (cookies/auth) persist across sessions - persistent state, not a machine snapshot. No pause/standby/checkpoint concept in docs or OpenAPI.

snapshot_on_demand.note: OpenAPI has only /task, /task/{id}/event, /profile, /file, /extension, /browser/session - no snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint. Profiles ('Profiles persist cookies and authentication across tasks.') are the only reusable state.

own_agent_api.quote: Submits a task to be executed by the Smooth agent.
own_agent_api.note: Harness = Smooth's own browser agent only ('Currently, only `smooth` is available.'). POST /task with a natural-language prompt, GET /task/{id} polls status/events (event_t cursor), POST /task/{id}/event sends follow-up run_task/goto/extract/evaluate_js/close and custom-tool responses, DELETE cancels, GET /task lists tasks. The agent runs in Smooth's cloud next to the browser; no Claude Code/Codex inside (the CLI gives Claude Code/OpenClaw a Smooth browser, the reverse direction).

harness_api.quote: Submits a task to be executed by the Smooth agent.
harness_api.note: Harness = Smooth's own browser agent only ('Currently, only `smooth` is available.'). POST /task with a natural-language prompt, GET /task/{id} polls status/events (event_t cursor), POST /task/{id}/event sends follow-up run_task/goto/extract/evaluate_js/close and custom-tool responses, DELETE cancels, GET /task lists tasks. The agent runs in Smooth's cloud next to the browser; no Claude Code/Codex inside (the CLI gives Claude Code/OpenClaw a Smooth browser, the reverse direction).

egress_allowlist.quote: List of allowed URL patterns using wildcard syntax. If None, all URLs are allowed.
egress_allowlist.note: allowed_urls on sessions and tasks (e.g. ["google.com/*", "*mydomain.*//*"]); set by the API caller, and the agent/user has no shell in the browser VM, so effectively provider-side. Enforcement mechanism (navigation-only vs all subresource traffic, network-level) is not documented. Proxies / P2P tunnel ('proxy_server="self"') are IP routing, not allowlists.

guest_firewall.note: No shell/process/root access to the browser machine at all - control is only via agent tasks, goto/extract/evaluate_js (page JavaScript). Isolation technology undocumented.

secret_proxy.quote: Your credentials stay on your machine and in the secure profile storage. The agent never sees your password.
secret_proxy.note: No credential-injection proxy or secret store. Credentials reach the agent via task text or metadata ('A dictionary containing variables or parameters that will be passed to the agent.'), or you log in manually via live view and the cookies are saved to a profile (the quote refers to this). Custom tools run in your own environment, so API keys for tool calls can stay out of Smooth - a pattern, not a proxy.

volume_attach.note: No volumes; file upload/download only ('Files can be reused across multiple tasks but are automatically deleted from our servers after 24 hours.').

volume_shared.note: No shared filesystem; uploaded files (24 h retention) can be passed to multiple tasks by id.
